designVerdict: SELECTED as LED1-8, the status chain. Side-emitting SK6812 variant.
notes: Side-emitting, 3.2 x 1.1 mm. Replaces SK6812MINI-E (C5149201), a 3.5 x 3.5 mm top-view part. In an enclosure a top-view indicator needs a window in the lid; a side-view one shines out the board edge, which is where someone looking at a wall-mounted controller already is.
ELECTRICALLY THE SAME FAMILY: IDOUT 10.5/12/13.5 mA against the MINI-E's 10/12/14.5 mA, VIH 0.65 x VDD, VDD 3.7-5.5 V. The 0.12 W budgeted figure (eight, one colour, 25% duty) is unchanged.

PIN ORDER DIFFERS FROM THE MINI-E: 1 GND / 2 DOUT / 3 DIN / 4 VDD here, against 1 GND / 2 DIN / 3 VDD / 4 DOUT there. DIN and VDD are swapped. A netlist written for one part is wrong for the other, which is the failure the standing rule about pin numbers exists for.

WHAT SIDE-EMITTING REQUIRES is a clear path in the emission direction - the light leaves parallel to the board, so nothing tall may stand in front. The edge is the natural place because that is where an enclosure opening goes, but the constraint is line of sight, not the edge itself. And edge is not scarce: eight at 3.2 mm plus spacing is 34 mm of a 292 mm perimeter, of which only 75 mm carries the connectors and the antenna keep-out.
Price 8 x $0.113 = $0.90 against $0.65. Stock 52k against 187k - both ample.
